title: US export-control directive forces Anthropic to suspend Fable 5 and Mythos 5 worldwide
summary: Days after launch, the US government issued an emergency export-control directive barring foreign nationals from accessing Fable 5 and Mythos 5 over a reported jailbreak; Anthropic disabled both models for all customers globally and disputed the basis.
reason: First government-forced withdrawal of a deployed frontier model, via unilateral national-security export control. Skeptic pass: T2-T3; kept T3 (within one tier).

title: SpaceX, owner of xAI, lists on Nasdaq at ~$1.75T
summary: SpaceX, which absorbed xAI as SpaceXAI, began trading as SPCX after a $135/share IPO raising ~$75B, the largest ever, and closed up ~25% on day one.
reason: Massive capital to an AI/compute conglomerate with large lab compute contracts.

title: CISA cuts federal patch window to three days citing AI-driven attacks
summary: CISA ordered agencies to patch the most serious flaws within three days because AI is speeding up exploitation.
reason: Official recognition of AI-accelerated cyber threat.

title: 'Agentjacking' attack tricks AI coding agents into running malicious code
summary: Researchers showed fake Sentry error reports with markdown injection could hijack agents like Claude Code and Cursor.

title: Japan revises government cybersecurity standards for AI-enabled attacks
summary: Japan's National Cyber Director's Office tightened incident reporting and MFA rules to counter AI-enabled cyberattacks.

title: Chinese humanoid robot makers race to IPO: EngineAI files in Hong Kong, Unitree seeks $7B
summary: Shenzhen's EngineAI filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO after starting T800 shipments, as Unitree and others pursue listings.
